decision_rule: A comparison is clear only when mean accuracy is greater and the first model wins at least 4 of 5 evaluation seeds.
methodology_note: An abandoned pre-correction local run had previously touched seeds 3001-3005 using the superseded model/coordinate design. The corrected models were not tuned from those results; the corrected run keeps the preregistered seeds as a canonical held-out replication rather than claiming the seed identities were never executed anywhere.
